status: identified library limitation in test forward path
cause: CT ModelCompressor.decompress_model uses an independent module loop and explicitly does not support distributed decompression. Recoupled ranks share compressed DiskCache filenames. A source replacement deletes a file while its peer still onloads it.
repair_contract: Assert restored compressed values on shared disk on every rank; materialize each tiny model with CT remove_dispatch(onload_tensors=True); execute forward on private CPU state on every rank. Preserve single-process disk-forward tests and original failure evidence.
production_scope: No production quantization/save changes; distributed post-save sample generation is already disabled. No claim that CT distributed decompression is supported.
